note: Halo blueprint, section 2. Same shape as docs/c4/model.json, finer: L3 components inside HaloModel and HaloApp with the files each owns. status is existing when any of its paths is on origin/dev 956d946, planned otherwise. Not read by scripts/ci; docs/c4/model.json stays the gate.

people.name: Motion designer
people.description: Makes short animated graphics: titles, stings, social posts.

systems.name: creative-apps
systems.description: Halo's part of the macOS app shells.

containers.name: HaloModel
containers.description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Halo's window: the project document, selection, playhead and playback, keys and easing, undo history, file state and render state, plus one contract per use case with its fake and live conformance. Calls FlareCore for keys, easing, sampling and matrices and CoreRaster for pixels.

components.name: Project and compositions
components.description: HaloProject: the window's one value-type state. Holds the document (compositions, selection, id counter) as a HaloDocumentState, the services, and every stored property v1 needs (history, playback, viewer drag, selected keys, file, rendered frame, render job, last refusal), each written only by its own extension file. Composition new, duplicate, rename (look-alike names refused), delete, select; the New Composition draft and settings; status text; edit(_:control:coalesceKey:_:), the one place an edit records undo, and endCoalescing().

components.name: Layers
components.description: HaloLayer (kind, span, color, opacity, CoreRaster blend mode, solid rectangle, and from W0 keyframe tracks keyed by HaloProperty, parent id and text content; Codable) and each kind's own box and default property values.

components.name: Timeline and playback
components.description: Each composition's playhead and timecode, the strip's rows with key frames, in and out points at the playhead (I and O), and from W1 play, pause, loop, step and the tick that advances the playhead through PlaybackClock.

components.name: Commands and availability
components.description: HaloCommand: every menu, toolbar and key command of v1, by area, with its title, and HaloProject.unavailableHelp(for:): nil when it can act now, else the reason the control shows. It dispatches to one file per area under Availability/; W0 writes them as stubs and each feature replaces its own area's file when its action works.

components.name: Use-case contracts
components.description: One protocol per use case (FrameDrawing, LayerPlacing, PropertyKeying, ViewerDragging, KeyEasing, ProjectHistory, ProjectFiles, PlaybackClock, FrameRendering, TextRasterizing, RenderSink, CompositionRendering) and the values they speak (HaloProperty, HaloDrawList, HaloDocumentState, HaloHistory, HaloKeyRef, HaloEasingPreset, the render plan and the error enums). FlareCore's Keyframe, Easing, Matrix and Point under Halo names.

relationships.description: names FlareCore Keyframe, Easing, Matrix and Point

components.name: Services and live conformances
components.description: HaloServices: one existential per contract with its .fake and .live values. Live/ holds one file per contract: a W0 stub that says why its controls are disabled, replaced whole by its feature with the real conformance over FlareCore and CoreRaster.

components.name: Fakes and fixtures
components.description: One fake per contract, small and predictable, for views, snapshots and journeys before the live types land; HaloFixtures builds the named fixture projects (empty, three-layers, keyed, parented, two-comps, reference, crowd) in code.

components.name: Viewer state
components.description: The viewer's draw list at the playhead (FrameDrawing plus the live drag offset), the viewer hit and drag: begin on the topmost layer under the pointer, move as a preview that never records undo, commit on mouse-up as one 'Move' step through ViewerDragging.

relationships.description: records the Move step through edit

components.name: Keys and easing
components.description: The inspector's property rows for the selected layer at the playhead; set value, stopwatch, key-here diamond and parent, each one named step (scrubs coalesce); selected keys on the timeline and setting their easing as one 'Keyframe Easing' step.

components.name: Layer housekeeping
components.description: Delete, rename, reorder and duplicate a layer of the selected composition, each one named step; a parent that is deleted leaves its children in place.

components.name: Undo and redo
components.description: undo() and redo() of whole-document steps through ProjectHistory, their menu titles, and the rule that selection, scrubbing and playback are not steps.

components.name: Project files
components.description: fileData() through ProjectFiles; beginOpen and finishOpen around a decode the app runs off the main actor; the file name and path, unsaved flag, the last save or open error, and the Open Recent list (name and path; HaloApp persists it). Opening clears history.

components.name: Rendered frames
components.description: FrameRenderer composites a frame with CoreRaster (today: axis-aligned solids; from W1 every v1 layer kind at its world transform, through FrameRendering) and the rendered frame Render Frame shows in the viewer, with when it goes stale.

components.name: Render to files
components.description: The Render… job: settings, the plan, progress ('Frame 48 of 240'), cancel and the outcome, driving CompositionRendering into a RenderSink the app supplies. HaloRenderJob+Kernel.swift is the adapter onto SuiteKernel's ExportRun (core-loop): every render-job transition goes through the kernel.

components.name: Text layers
components.description: Set a text layer's string and size, each one named step; an empty string is refused.

containers.name: HaloApp
containers.description: The Halo app: the SwiftUI scene, the window and its views built from SuiteUI, the menus, and the macOS-only platform pieces (file type, PNG and movie writers, text rasterizer, frame image). Reads HaloModel and calls its methods; never writes its state (scripts/ci app-state rule).

components.name: App scene and launch
components.description: The App scene (WindowGroup, commands) and the launch arguments that pick services and data for journeys: -HaloFixture, -HaloSample, -HaloOpenFile, -HaloSaveTo, -HaloRenderTo, -HaloWindowSize, -HaloPerfProbe.

components.name: Window and command router
components.description: HaloWindow (today inside HaloApp.swift; W0 moves it to its own file): the one @State model, every presentation flag v1 needs, and perform(_ command: HaloCommand), which routes each command to its area file (HaloWindow+Viewer, +Playback, +Keys, +Layers, +Edit, +File, +Easing, +Render, +Text). W0 writes the router and stub area files; each feature owns one area file. HaloControls gathers every halo.* control's id, enabled state and help into the halo.controls JSON (under -HaloControlsProbe) for the every-control journey.

components.name: Menus
components.description: Composition, Layer, File, Edit and Animation menus. Every item sends a HaloCommand through the focused window and is disabled, with the Model's reason as help, when it can't act.

components.name: Viewer
components.description: The viewer (HaloViewer, today inside HaloApp.swift; W0 moves it to HaloViewer.swift): the artboard (CanvasSurface) with the draw list painted in a SwiftUI Canvas, the selection outline, the drag gesture, the rendered-frame image (HaloRenderedFrameView), the status bar and the transport; the display-link playback driver. HaloProbe.swift records the viewer drag, playhead, playback and scroll series into the window's frame probe under -SuitePerfProbe (core-loop).

relationships.description: reads the draw list, calls the drag

components.name: Timeline view
components.description: The strip under the viewer: one lane per layer with its span and key diamonds, the playhead, scrub, I and O, key selection and the key context menu.

relationships.description: reads rows, calls scrub and points

components.name: Inspector
components.description: The inspector: the composition header and rows, the layer list (select, rename, reorder, delete), the selected layer's TRANSFORM rows with keyframe buttons, parent and blend pickers, the EASING group (chips and curve) and the TEXT section.

relationships.description: InspectorHeader, InspectorSection, StudioScrubRow, KeyframeButton, InspectorPickerRow, ChoiceChips, CurveEditor, InspectorColorRow

components.name: Sheets and alerts
components.description: New Composition sheet, the rename refusal alert (until SuiteUI #577), and the Render… sheet with progress and Cancel.

relationships.description: reads the job, starts and cancels it

components.name: Platform pieces
components.description: macOS-only conformances and conversions with no SwiftUI: the .halo UTType, the rendered frame as a CGImage (from CoreRaster rgba8), the PNG sequence writer (ImageIO) and movie writer (AVFoundation) as RenderSinks, and the CoreText TextRasterizing.

containers.name: Halo tests
containers.description: HaloModelTests (Linux and macOS), Halo's snapshot, golden and latency files in AppSnapshotTests (macOS), and Halo's UI journeys.

components.name: HaloModelTests
components.description: Model behavior, contract conformance suites run against both the fake and the live type, fixtures, budgets (HaloBudgetTests) and Linux fidelity checks (render reference pixels, file round trip).

components.name: Halo snapshots and goldens
components.description: Halo*Snapshots.swift PNGs in Light and Dark, goldens once QH-2 (#331) lands, HaloViewerFidelityTests (viewer equals render) and HaloViewerLatencyTests.

components.name: Halo journeys
components.description: UITests/HaloJourneyTests.swift and, once QH-4 (#333) lands, one HaloJourneyTests+<Area>.swift per feature: the journeys H-J0 to H-J23 and the perf journeys H-P1 to H-P5 with a whole-window shot per step and the app audit on every shot.

components.description: The shared design system (Sources/SuiteUI).
